Question: A function \(f\) has domain \([0, 2]\) and range \([0, 1].\) (The notation \([a, b]\) denotes \(\{x : a \le x \le b\}.\)) What are the domain and range, respectively, of the function \(g\) defined by \[g(x) = 1 - f(x + 1)?\]
